svg.title: Measure pages, not people: a beacon dies at the first gate it fails
svg.desc: edgeglint level 0 as deployed. Top: what the tracker reads and never reads, and the script gate that sends an empty script to excluded countries. Middle: the seven gates a beacon passes in order, every rejection answering 204 with nothing written, then the fields of a stored row and the dashboard read path. Bottom: the level ladder from docs/tiers.md, and bot defence as a separate optional layer. Detail: docs/kb/privacy-solution.md.
svg.text: Measure pages, not people: a beacon dies at the first gate it fails
edgeglint · one-page design · revised 2026-10-29 · level 0 as deployed on dataxad.com and folocard.com · Cloudflare Worker + Analytics Engine · no cookies, no visitor identifier
In the browser: tracker.js
Reads
pathname (never the query string), viewport width
group s / m / l, referrer host, scroll depth, dwell,
LCP, CLS, clicks, error names, outbound links
Never
cookies, storage, identifiers, page content, exact
width, error messages, the IP (the edge reads it)
GPC, DNT or opt-out cookie t=0: it sends nothing.
Before any of that: the script gate
GET the tracker script. The edge answers
with an empty script, two slashes, when the
request country is excluded or COLLECT is off.
Excluded: EEA, UK, CH and their territories,
unknown country XX, Tor T1. Nothing runs there.
Collection never starts there.
POST /api/t, same origin, HTTPS, one beacon per flush
At the edge: seven gates in this order (collect.js)
any no: 204, Cache-Control no-store, nothing written. A rejection looks exactly like an acceptance, so a 204 is not proof of ingestion.
One stored row (Analytics Engine, 3-month retention, sampled)

g.text: No visitor field: two rows from one person cannot be joined. Later flushes correct maxima with a weighted row, not an ID.
Raw IP and raw User-Agent never reach a row: the IP is only the rate-limit key, the User-Agent only feeds the bot check
and the family names. Request logs redact the query string. Timestamp is the write time. No archive, no delete API.

svg.text: Reading it back
The dashboard Worker queries the dataset through the
Analytics SQL binding: no API token, answers cached 60 s,
sample weights already applied. Login is a separate
HttpOnly cookie for 30 days, never a measurement.
Exports and filters must not single out a person through
small groups: the counsel question stays open (#34).
The level ladder (docs/tiers.md): start at 0, climb only after counsel
LEVEL 0 · LIVE
No identifiers: pageviews, referrer visits, routes, scroll, clicks, errors, LCP, CLS.
LEVEL 1 · #6
Daily unique browsers from a daily site HMAC of IP and User-Agent. WP29 and CNIL:
fingerprinting; rotation does not undo it. Proposed flag, not built; counsel first.
LEVEL 2 · #10
Coverage in excluded countries after valid prior consent, or a French exemption
profile. CONSENT_MODE and GEO_MODE=cnil proposed, not built. No earlier visits.
LEVEL 3 · EXT
Session replay and heatmaps: another product with its own vendor review.
Never "compliant" or "banner-free": no cookie is not an exemption (EDPB 2/2023 ¶53). Counsel packet #34.
Bot defence: another layer, an option
Today, inside the gauntlet
gates 3, 4, 6: the verified-bot category, the User-Agent regex, the IP rate limiter.
Bot rows are dropped, never labelled or stored.
Optional edge layer: when bot rows show, or writes near the free 100k / day
a Cloudflare rate or WAF rule scoped to the /api/t path (the Undermine pattern, #686);
a bot-score threshold where the plan has one; never zone-wide Bot Fight Mode.
Never for analytics
a client challenge (Turnstile) for a page view. A visit is not a service the visitor
asked us to protect, and ePrivacy 5(3) has no legitimate-interest exemption:
bot filtering is minimisation, not a legal basis.
Detail: docs/kb/privacy-solution.md · Sources: src/collect.js, src/tracker.js, docs/data-flow.md, docs/tiers.md · the Undermine admission page shows the game-side ladder
